Self-hosted web fonts for the Editions covers. All are SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). Each file is the Google Fonts "latin" unicode-range
subset of a single static instance, downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com
via the css2 API request shown.

bricolage-grotesque-96pt-extrabold-latin.woff2
  Bricolage Grotesque (Mathieu Triay), gstatic v9, opsz 96 · wdth 100 · wght 800
  css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wdth,wght@96,100,800
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/bricolagegrotesque/v9/3y9U6as8bTXq_nANBjzKo3IeZx8z6up5BeSl5jBNz_19PpZJMnuECpwUxJBOm_OJWiaaD30YfKfjZZoLvZvl-Molss4MHt0GOQ.woff2
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage)

  Fraunces (Undercase Type), gstatic v38, opsz 144 · wght 600 · SOFT 100 · WONK 1
  css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght,SOFT,WONK@144,600,100,1
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/fraunces/v38/6NUh8FyLNQOQZAnv9bYEvDiIdE9Ea92usiIk_WBq8U_9v0c2WS017iN7hzFUPJH58njr1a03gg7S2nfgRYIcaRyTCf7Tp05GNyXk.woff2

  css2?family=Inter:wght@400 / css2?family=Inter:wght@600

  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcCO3FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIw2boKoduKmMEVuGKYAZ9hiJ-Ek-_EeA.woff2

jetbrains-mono-medium-latin.woff2
  JetBrains Mono (JetBrains), gstatic v24, wght 500
  css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/jetbrainsmono/v24/tDbY2o-flEEny0FZhsfKu5WU4zr3E_BX0PnT8RD8-qxTOlOVk6OThhvA.woff2
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)

The latin subset covers U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6,
U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191,
U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD. It has no U+2192 (→).

Cover display faces (fronts). Each file is the Google Fonts "latin" unicode-range subset of a
single static instance, downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com via the css2 API request
shown, except Hanken Grotesk (copied from the Topshine repo, see below).

The other cover fronts (Mirra, LikeWiki, Scorecard, Xactions, About Neil) use the page's UI face,
ui/inter-variable-ui.woff2, at weights 800 and 900. Backs use Bricolage Grotesque, Inter and
JetBrains Mono above. fraunces-144pt-semibold-soft-wonk-latin.woff2 and inter-{regular,semibold}-latin.woff2
are no longer loaded by the covers.
